component.name: CADD Calculator
component.summary: Drafting calculators that show their work

description.p: Open-source calculators for drafting and design. Every result shows its work: the formula in symbols, then with your numbers, then the value. It names its method and source, and says how far that method has been checked.

ul.li: Geometry: arcs and sectors, circles, rectangles, regular polygons, and triangles
Conversions: length, angle, area, stress and pressure, and fractions and decimals
Sheet metal: bend allowance and deduction, flat lengths, cone layouts, and V-die openings

description.p: Type values in inches or millimeters, as decimals, fractions, or mixed numbers. The app makes no network calls.
